newsitem.title: USA: Boeing monitoring Lockheed merger. [CORRECTED 22:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Boeing monitoring Lockheed merger. [CORRECTED 22:50 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects by changing headline from "Boeing sees little effect from Lockheed deal.")

Boeing Co is following with interest Lockheed Martin Corp's planned $11.6 billion acquisition of rival Northrop Grumman Corp, a spokeswoman for the aerospace giant said Thursday. (Corrects from "Boeing Co does not expect any major changes from Lockheed Martin Corp's planned $11.6 billion acquisition of rival Northrop Grumman Corp...")
"Boeing has longstanding relationships with both Lockheed Martin and Northrop Grumman, and we would expect those relationships to continue for the foreseeable future," Boeing's Sherry Nebel said.
"We will continue to monitor the transaction as it moves through the approval process."

Nebel called the merger a continuation of industry consolidation that has been advocated by the U.S. Department of Defense, which also was cited as a factor in Boeing's decision to acquire McDonnell Douglas Corp in a $14 billion deal expected to close August 1.
